subject: [PATCH v3 1/7] selftests/mm: add MADV_COLD and MADV_PAGEOUT contract tests

2026-10-19.patch_summary: This patch adds a selftest harness to test the behavior of MADV_COLD and MADV_PAGEOUT hints in Linux. The tests cover basic behavior, including that neither hint populates PTE holes or faults swapped pages back in, and neither can be applied to locked VMAs. Additionally, the tests pin the process to its starting CPU to ensure accurate results. This patch is part of a larger series of patches that aim to improve the testing of memory management features in Linux.
